title: The job shop, solved: makespan 11
description: The optimal schedule that examples/job_shop.rs prints, one bar per operation, grouped by machine. Machine M0 runs job 0 from 0 to 3 and job 1 from 3 to 5. M1 runs job 2 from 0 to 4, job 0 from 4 to 6 and job 1 from 6 to 10. M2 runs job 1 from 5 to 6, job 2 from 6 to 9 and job 0 from 9 to 11. No machine runs two operations at once, every job keeps its order of operations, and the last operation ends at 11.
source: examples/output/job_shop.txt (cargo run --example job_shop), durations from JOBS in examples/job_shop.rs
